ReleaseNotes: UI Font Color fixes found in Administration->SNMP & Site Dashboard-> SNMP Decode Values.
Changed the Test button on Network Pane to not overwrite current ping stats in write-up (good find Travis).
Corrected Pings continuing even after write-up submissions (good find David).
Added a full TOP Change workflow with Ticket life-cycle metadata.
Added "Bad from Stock" option for blank Equipment Cards.
Added pressing 'Enter' after putting number in the Ping Count textbox starts pings in both Network Pane and Tower Views.
Changed Equipment cards textbox Titles and watermarks.
Allow Dispatch to set a Work Order Type in both New/Edit Ticket Window and Bulk WO Type without having a Work Order Number present.
Adding a tech AFTER a ticket is closed now adds that ticket to that techs' history.
Double-clicking a ticket in Field Tech History Grid, now expands/collapses that ticket.
Added PMR SN search on RX Tab give WAN IP if it exists.
